name: pay-bands-table
title: Pay bands table
description: Published salary bands by role family and level, with a zone switch, a bar for each range and a plain note on how pay is set.
docs: bands are keyed by zone id; a level without a band in the chosen zone says so in words. The bars share one scale across every zone, so they move when the zone changes, and the two ends of the scale are written in the Range heading. Pass zone and onZoneChange to control the switch, or defaultZone to start on another zone; with a single zone the switch is left out. Amounts are written from currency and locale without decimals. List the levels from the first rung up. On a phone each bar sits under its level so the table fits; one that is still too wide scrolls inside its own container with the level column held in place. notes takes the facts about the rest of the package (bonus, equity, review cycle) and methodology a plain paragraph on how bands are set.
